canon.name: I'M IN
canon.frame: a full screen view of I'M IN, a made up hacker operating system from a 1990s movie thriller, its interface filling the whole frame edge to edge, seen flat and straight on by a locked static camera, evenly lit
canon.still: The screen is perfectly still for the whole clip
canon.approach: In the first half second, {thing} flares bright green and pulses
canon.arrive: {thing} slams open {place} in a burst of green static, already alive with streaming code and flashing readouts
canon.leave: {thing} collapses into a thin glowing green line and snaps away
canon.settle: In the last second everything comes to rest and the screen holds steady as a clean sharp picture, every icon and button in its place while faint green characters drift down behind it
canon.ambient: A deep computer hum with soft electronic chirps
canon.lettering: small crisp glowing green monospace capitals
canon.style: flat glowing green on black screen capture
